mechanism: Nortriptyline's anticholinergic and noradrenergic effects can antagonize levodopa's therapeutic efficacy and increase sympathomimetic side effects, while levodopa may potentiate tricyclic antidepressant-induced cardiovascular effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure, cardiac function, and Parkinson's symptom control; consider alternative antidepressant (SSRI) if interaction becomes clinically significant; dosage adjustment may be needed.
